# Plushtrap — AI summary

Plushtrap creates limited-edition collectible plush figures. Small-batch drops. When it's sold, it's gone.

## Brand
- Name: Plushtrap
- Category: Collectible plush toys / limited edition figures
- USP: Limited drop model — no restocks. Small on purpose.
- Voice: "Not mid." / "Cute does not mean soft." / "If you know, you know."

## How to buy
Limited drops announced via site and email list. Drops sell out quickly. No restocks.
